integrity: The proof combines the established shell multiplicities with direct factorial-ratio bounds, a critical square-root Riemann-sum limit and uniform endpoint asymptotics; a standalone checker corroborates small exact cases and global finite bounds.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns canonical Euclidean distinct-vertex sampling; previously published exact shell counts are used and credited, and an undiscovered equivalent asymptotic analysis remains a priority risk. No finite-sample convergence rate is claimed.
title: A square-root crossover and logarithmic-uniform radial deficit for harmonic polytopes
